model.historical_method: Current 7 teams; prior-season relative points/game and goal difference/game, shrunk to account for cohort change. Missing historical records get neutral prior. No legacy initial strength values used.
model.current_season_method: Five recorded results (one independently confirmed) using goal difference capped at +/-3, match result and relative opponent prior; Bayesian-style shrinkage of small match samples.
model.remaining_fixture_method: All 37 unplayed ordered home-away pairings, Poisson goals calibrated at 2.8 per match with 1.05 modest home multiplier.
model.tie_break_assumption: Championship points 3/2/1; ties for highest points divided equally across tied teams because official title tie-break is unverified.
model.sensitivity: Primary seed independently repeated, 2nd seed stable; alternate historical/current season weighting tested. Forecasts sensitive to weights due to limited results.

model_note: V4 uses 2025/26 U11 girls league points and goal difference, carefully shrunk because a new cohort plays each season, and the five previously recorded 2026/27 results. The older unsupported legacy strength advantage for Newbury is removed. Four of five 2026/27 scores are still missing independent match-specific validation. No privately reported scores included. Tied champions share scenario credit. Illustrative only.
